description: Create a full-screen dramatic results announce/reveal page at GET /events/:eventId/announce. The page reveals placements one click at a time (3rd → 2nd → 1st) with animations, confetti for champion, and keyboard navigation. Independent of FEAT-001 — only depends on the existing resultsPage ranking logic already in scoringController.js.
steps: Step 1 — Add announcePage controller in controllers/scoringController.js. Export 'export const announcePage = async (req, res) => {...}'. Fetch event, contestants, criteria, scores (same four Promise.all as resultsPage). Compute ranked using the identical loop as resultsPage (copy the ranked/breakdown/finalScore computation, ranked.sort, applyTieBreaking, rank/gapToFirst assignment). Take only the top 3 (or all if fewer than 3): const top = ranked.slice(0, Math.min(ranked.length, 3)). Reverse for reveal order: top.reverse() so index 0 = 3rd (or last), last index = 1st (champion). Pass to template: res.render('scoring/announce', { title: 'Announce — ' + ev.name, event: ev, placements: top, userName: req.session.userName, userRole: req.session.userRole, userInitial: (req.session.userName||'U')[0].toUpperCase(), isAdmin: req.session.userRole==='admin' }). The placements array items have: rank, name, barangay, number, photo, finalScoreDisplay.

Step 2 — Add route in routes/index.js. Add announcePage to the destructured import from scoringController. Add route: router.get('/events/:eventId/announce', requireAuth, announcePage); — place it immediately after the /events/:eventId/results route.

Step 3 — Create views/scoring/announce.xian. This is a STANDALONE page — do NOT use {{> head }}, {{> navbar }}, {{> sidebar }}. Start with full <!DOCTYPE html>. Structure: (a) <head> with Inter font from Google Fonts, TailwindCDN, title '{{title}} — ScoreSync', and all CSS inline in <style>; (b) <body style='background:#060b18;margin:0;overflow:hidden;font-family:Inter,sans-serif;color:#fff'>.

Step 4 — Implement the START SCREEN in announce.xian. Show: centered flex column, event name in small uppercase tracking-widest text, 'OFFICIAL RESULTS' in large bold white text, crown emoji 👑 at ~5rem, 'Click to Begin Reveal' button (gold gradient, rounded-full, px-8 py-3). On click: hide start screen, show reveal container. Store placements data as a JS array embedded in a <script> tag using Handlebars: const PLACEMENTS = [{{#each placements}}{rank:{{rank}},name:{{jsonStr name}},barangay:{{jsonStr barangay}},number:{{jsonStr number}},photo:{{jsonStr photo}},finalScoreDisplay:{{jsonStr finalScoreDisplay}}}{{#unless @last}},{{/unless}}{{/each}}]; — NOTE: jsonStr must be a Handlebars helper that JSON.stringify-escapes the value. If that helper is not available, use triple-stash {{{jsonStr value}}} or embed data via a <script id='placements-data' type='application/json'> block and JSON.parse it in JS. Use the <script type='application/json'> approach to be safe: <script id='placements-data' type='application/json'>{{placementsJson}}</script> — pass placementsJson: JSON.stringify(top) from the controller.

Step 5 — Implement the REVEAL MECHANIC in announce.xian JS. State: let step = 0. On each click/spacebar/ArrowRight: show placements[step], increment step, disable advance when step >= placements.length. Each reveal card: full-screen centered card with rank badge label (3rd = 'BRONZE' #cd7f32, 2nd = 'SILVER' #94a3b8, 1st = 'CHAMPION' gold #f59e0b), contestant photo (round, 128px) or number fallback, contestant name (text-3xl font-black), barangay (text-lg opacity-70), final score (text-5xl font-black with color matching rank). Animate each card in with a CSS keyframe: @keyframes revealIn { from { opacity:0; transform: translateY(40px) scale(0.92); } to { opacity:1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } } applied with animation: revealIn 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) forwards.

Step 6 — Champion reveal extras in announce.xian. When step reaches the last placement (rank 1 / champion): add a CSS-only confetti effect using 40 <div> elements injected by JS, each positioned absolutely with random left%, random animation-delay, falling from top to bottom with a rotate+fall keyframe (@keyframes fall). Gold glow on the champion card: box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(245,158,11,0.5), 0 0 120px rgba(245,158,11,0.2). Show a 'Restart' button after all placements are revealed.

Step 7 — Keyboard + bottom branding in announce.xian. Add keydown listener: Space and ArrowRight advance; ArrowLeft goes back one step (re-renders previous card). Bottom of page (position:fixed, bottom:20px, width:100%, text-center): event name in small text + '· ScoreSync' branding, opacity:0.4.

Step 8 — Add 'Announce Results' link to views/scoring/results.xian sticky bar. This is also done in FEAT-001 step 3 — if FEAT-001 already added it, skip this step. If FEAT-002 runs first (or independently), add: 🎉 Announce in the sticky bar flex container, after the Export CSV button.
acceptance_criteria: GET /events/:eventId/announce returns 200 HTML page (no sidebar/navbar) with the start screen
Clicking 'Click to Begin Reveal' shows the first placement card (lowest rank first)
Each subsequent click reveals the next placement with the fade/slide animation
The champion reveal shows a gold glow and confetti animation
Spacebar and arrow keys advance/go back through placements
A 'Restart' button appears after all placements are shown
Bottom branding shows event name + ScoreSync
verification: Start server, navigate to /events/:eventId/announce, verify start screen appears, click through all reveals, confirm animations and champion confetti render correctly in browser
findings: Implemented announcePage controller in scoringController.js. Added GET /events/:eventId/announce route in routes/index.js immediately after the resultsPage route. Created standalone views/scoring/announce.xian with start screen, card-by-card reveal (3rd→2nd→champion), CSS revealIn animation, confetti on champion, keyboard navigation (Space/ArrowRight/ArrowLeft), and fixed branding footer. Used triple-stash {{{placementsJson}}} to prevent Handlebars HTML-escaping of the embedded JSON. Announce link in results.xian was already present from FEAT-001 — step 8 skipped. Both modified JS files pass node --check.
